usedFor: TidyCal holds bookings and teams, and Keka receives a new employee through “Add an new employee”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a user is added to a team” in TidyCal, then “Add an new employee” in Keka
bestTemplate.why: A user joining a team can create the employee record in Keka.

watchOut: “Add an new employee” in Keka takes personal, job and salary details, so supply them in the step.
